name: Cotopaxi
band_note: core tee $35 and core blouse $65 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Brightly coloured outdoor jackets, fleece and travel packs for women and men, with down jackets around $295 and Allpa packs $205–255, sold through its own stores, site and Nordstrom.
origin: Founded in Salt Lake City, United States in 2013 by Davis Smith.

ownership.owner: Cotopaxi (private company; Bain Capital Double Impact is an investor)

quote.q: Adventure inspires us to see the world and make it better.

opview: “Adventure inspires us to see the world and make it better.” — Cotopaxi (house), About Us (Our Mission), cotopaxi.com

facts_read.source: brand site; B Lab directory profile; Fortune Leadership Next transcript 2023-02-23; nordstrom.com search; Vinted catalogue; TRR designer directory; GOTS database

Blouse.hp: Afuera Button Up Shirt - Print - Women's

price_read.sublines: Cotopaxi women's apparel and outerwear (tags women/bc1-womens), in stock; packs, equipment, men's, kids excluded

doors.note: Own-store page lists 20 US locations: 16 full-price (incl. SLC Airport, Jackson NEW), 3 outlets (Castle Rock, Seattle Premium Outlets, Settlers Green), 1 Brooklyn pop-up (not counted). Non-US: 6 Japan, 3 Korea (1 pop-up). Separate Authorized Retailers page (/pages/store-locator) = wholesale, not counted. Not a large chain; full list on one page.

fibre.sample: stratified sample of 80 drawn from 112 in-stock women's apparel + outerwear styles (titles deduped across colour/print products); 8 sampled rows were men's-name

tech_evidence.names: PrimaLoft Gold P.U.R.E. insulation; Polygiene anti-odor; C0 (PFC-free) DWR; 800-fill responsibly sourced down
tech_evidence.owned: licensed (PrimaLoft, Polygiene); no house-owned fabric names
tech_evidence.share: about 20% of sampled styles name PrimaLoft or Polygiene; DWR stated on most shells

craft_evidence.makers: partial — a per-product 'Factory Information' tab describes the factory and links to a profile, but does not name it in the tab text; elsewhere generic Fair Trade Certified factories
craft_evidence.madein: about 10% — 7 of 72 sampled factory tabs state a country (Cambodia); the rest carry a generic Fair Trade statement or no
craft_evidence.heritage: vague: founder Davis Smith named, Utah-based foundation, impact reports since 2015; no founding date or place stated on the about-us page
craft_evidence.process: partial — fabric weight (gsm), recycled content and finish chemistry stated per product; no making process
craft_evidence.reasoning: Cotopaxi owns nothing and names no maker in its product text. It does publish a per-product factory tab that sometimes states the country (Cambodia) and links to a factory profile, which is more than most houses publish. Sourcing transparency, not making, so a 2.

notes.tech: Thread proposed 3 (2026-10-15): named fabrics PrimaLoft Gold P.U.R.E. insulation; Polygiene anti-odor; C0 (PFC-free) DWR; 800-fill responsibly sourced down, about 20% of sampled styles name PrimaLoft or Polygiene; DWR stated on most shells of the range. Seated as proposed, pending ruling.
